fullDesc: In October 2001 the US and allies invaded Afghanistan to topple the Taliban and hunt al-Qaeda after the September 11 attacks. The war lasted 20 years, ending with a chaotic withdrawal in August 2021 and a Taliban return to power.
realFacts: Tens of thousands of Afghan civilians died
Osama bin Laden was killed in Pakistan in 2011
The Taliban took Kabul in August 2021
